bosch_home.note: Bosch Home has 21 catalog categories; the only structurally sufficient page is a kettle on the German country site (field names only, values not retained). The UK air-fryer page lacks specifications and media. Category-routed Bosch rows are not part of this family.

scopes.discovery_route: structural: profile discovery layer confirmed, no catalog-row lookup route exercised
scopes.label: bosch-home.com/de/de kettle page
scopes.market_reason: The observed page is the German country site; no page for the catalog's market was observed and regional variants of one model differ.
scopes.note: Strongest identity signal in the project (gtin + mpn). Structure only; documents layer partial.

cudy.note: The only structurally sufficient page is a router on cudy.com. Switches, mesh systems, range extenders and Wi-Fi adapters share the storefront but no page for them was observed.

scopes.caveat: Stage 8 recorded protection_status=challenge_suspected on every cudy.com sample. No 401/403/429 is on record, so the host is not stopped, but the first request must go through the policy-aware fetcher and stop on any challenge.
scopes.discovery_route: structural: /collections/wi-fi-routers listed products; no catalog-row lookup exercised
scopes.label: cudy.com router page (WR6500H)
scopes.market_reason: cudy.com is the manufacturer's single global storefront.
scopes.note: Identity strategy not characterised yet; documents layer unconfirmed.

hyperx.note: Adapter wired into run_once() (Stage 14-16); 2 of 41 catalog rows have a confirmed exact URL. Fixtures are listed per category: hyperx.com is one global storefront, so the observed pages are in the catalog's market, but a keyboard page is a US layout.

scopes.label: hyperx.com microphone page (QuadCast 2S)
scopes.market_reason: hyperx.com is the manufacturer's single storefront; no country pages were observed.
scopes.note: Value-level card, exact_variant on the exact seller code.

scopes.label: hyperx.com mouse page (Pulsefire Fuse)
scopes.note: Live page with values, exact match on the seller code.

scopes.label: hyperx.com keyboard page (Alloy Rise 75, US layout)
scopes.market_reason: Same storefront; the page itself is the US layout (#ABA), which is why the RU row #ACB does not match.
scopes.note: Live page with values; base code matches the catalog row, regional suffix does not.

microsoft.note: Stage 13 called Microsoft 'full value'; Stage 10.2's own re-audit showed the page is the Xbox Series S line page on the en-US site with a variant selector, not an exact-variant page. Controllers, accessories, mice and headsets have no observed page.

scopes.discovery_route: landing pages listed by the xbox.com sitemap; no route to a per-variant page was observed
scopes.label: xbox.com (en-US) Xbox Series S line page
scopes.market_reason: The page is xbox.com/en-US; support.xbox.com/ru-RU answered with a bare JavaScript shell, so no page in the catalog's market was captured.
scopes.note: Identity is line-level (the seller article XXU-00015 is absent from the page), dimensions and weight are line-wide, the 14-image gallery has no colour-specific image.

playstation.note: Stage 13 called PlayStation 'full value'; Stage 9's own criterion check failed on specifications (qualitative text only) and on the catalog row (two candidate rows, code absent from the page). Both pages are on the US web-store, not the catalog's market. Consoles and every other category have no observed page.

scopes.discovery_route: category page -> product page was walked only inside the US store
scopes.label: PS Direct (en-us) accessory page: DualSense controller
scopes.market_reason: PS Direct is Sony's US web-store; its sku is the store's internal product id (1000050734), not the CFI-ZCT code. No page for the catalog's market was observed.
scopes.note: Identity is microdata (name, sku), not JSON-LD, so it needs its own parser. Stage 9 reached exact_model only: model and colour confirmed, the catalog cannot pick between CFI-ZCT1J 02 and CFI-ZCT1W_cosmic_red.

scopes.discovery_route: no route observed for the catalog's game category
scopes.label: PS Direct (en-us) game page: collector's edition
scopes.market_reason: US web-store page; Stage 8.2 itself doubts PS Direct maps to the catalog's plain game discs at all.
scopes.note: Ghost of Yotei Collector's Edition: microdata name+sku only, family_only against the catalog.

razer.note: robots.txt returned a 403 bot-challenge; Stage 12's Razer page data was collected after that block and is not valid evidence.

samsung.note: Stage 13 called Samsung 'full value'; the evidence is one microwave card plus two structural pages (TV, earbuds), all on samsung.com/kz_ru. adapter_profiles.v1.json still says product_page_not_found (stale). Every other Samsung catalog category has no observed Product page.

scopes.discovery_route: da-sitemap.xml link index (300 saved links, 37 microwave) matched by exact model code to the page slug; 1 exact hit for the 58 catalog microwave rows
scopes.label: Samsung kz_ru microwave ovens (solo)
scopes.market_reason: Observed on samsung.com/kz_ru, the market the source registry uses for Samsung.
scopes.note: Value-level card, identity exact_variant, content-verified manual. Six characteristics still have no confirmed value (weight, dimensions, turntable, controls, program counts, defrost modes).

scopes.discovery_route: b2c-sitemap.xml -> vd-sitemap.xml (TV) and im-sitemap.xml (audio) list product URLs, but the catalog rows targeted in Stage 8.2 were not reached (52-URL TV slice, 300-loc audio slice)
scopes.label: Samsung kz_ru TV and Galaxy Buds product pages
scopes.note: TV UE43N5300AUXCE and Galaxy Buds3 FE carry JSON-LD name+sku and one image. The specifications tab is client-rendered: the TV page has none, the earbuds page has qualitative body text only, no table. Identity meaning of the sku is unverified for the TV. The Galaxy Buds3 FE page matches no catalog row; the TV page was not carded.
